programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhens childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journeyher parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: Shes Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: Battle of the Wolf
programme.desc: On his flight home, former special forces sergeant Zhang Zhi Yong and his wife find themselves caught in a terrorist conspiracy masterminded by international criminals. Drawing on his unwavering courage and tactical expertise, he protects his wife and fellow passengers while dismantling the deadly plot and ensuring everyones safe return home.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandoras box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandoras Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: The Wolf Pack squad led by Lao Diao, is a foreign-based team that specializes in overseas security jobs. In one of the missions, the squad discovers that a terrorist force is planning to destroy the countrys energy source. Lao Diao is now entrusted with the task of leading his squad to fight back. Can the Wolf Pack save the day?

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, she is left alone at home when her husband is away on a work trip. An intruder enters Bos house and takes her hostage. As Bo tries to survive his mental and psychological torture, she discovers her husbands secret which is related to the accident leading to her blindness

programme.title: Shes Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Evas mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mothers wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Evas heart?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Adapted from a true story, the film follows Feng, a determined young man who defies his father to pursue his dream of becoming an automotive mechanic. Alongside his childhood friend Yun, he embarks on a daring journey that unexpectedly plunges them into the exhilarating world of racing, sparking a passionate coming-of-age adventure.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with Nan since she met him once as a child. After graduating high school, Zhi realizes that she and Nan are in the same university, where they get to know each other by chance and become close friends. However, Zhi is still too shy to express her love for Nan. Will this long-term crush finally turn into true love?

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive Zhi Shi Lang across the desert to Changan, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wongs caught in the Mongs territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Pings limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiangs popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lins sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces!

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knights days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the Flying Guillotine Squad, a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her familys massacre years ago.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the masters granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Ace
programme.desc: Kannan moves to a foreign country seeking life, but gets dragged into shark circle. A heist turns hope into a curse, forcing him to outsmart fate.

programme.title: Bhola Shankar
programme.desc: In Kolkata, a taxi driver fights to build a new life with his sister, but his dark past catches up with him as he battles the citys dangerous underworld.

programme.title: Idhu Kathirvelan Kadhal
programme.desc: Kathir, who hates marriage, is in Coimbatore to resolve a family dispute. There, he falls for Pavithra but his heart is broken when he discovers that she is in love with someone else.

programme.title: Maaman Magal
programme.desc: After a shocking revelation about her husband, a woman seeks a divorce, but then discovers she is pregnant, leading to a difficult decision.

programme.title: Rekka
programme.desc: A young man, known for helping couples elope, is forced by a gangster to kidnap a politicians daughter after he stops the wedding of a girl who didnt want to marry him.

programme.title: Desingu Raja
programme.desc: Idhyakani falls for Bindu Madhavi despite their families rivalry. The lovers try to unite them, but their efforts lead to a conflict between the families.

programme.title: Murder
programme.desc: After his beloved daughter elopes with an unworthy person, an emotional father chooses the hard path to make the corrections.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.desc: Krishna, an NRI, fights against injustice around him. When he comes across Jeetendra, a don seeking revenge against Krishnas family due to an old rivalry, Krishna must fight him and save his family.

programme.title: August 16 1947
programme.desc: Amid Indias independence celebration, the news fails to reach Sengadu, a remote village oppressed by Robert Clive. Param rises to lead the liberation of the villagers.

programme.title: Bimbisara
programme.desc: Betrayed by his brother, an ancient evil emperor is trapped in a mirror and transported to the modern world, where he desperately searches for the mirror to return to his kingdom.

programme.title: J Baby
programme.desc: Volatile mother leaves family without notice. Sons embark on journey to find her, bringing family drama to light.

programme.title: Biscoth
programme.desc: After the death of his father, Raja begins to work in his fathers company. He, however, finds his life changed when he befriends Janaki who narrates stories that come true for him.

programme.title: Maargan
programme.desc: A gripping action drama following a determined protagonist facing challenges, uncovering truths, and fighting against injustice.

programme.title: Ten Hours
programme.desc: A bus murder investigation unfolds, revealing possible scenarios and suspects. As people are questioned, deeper secrets surface, suggesting hidden motives and surprising links within the case.

programme.title: Kingston
programme.desc: In 1982, a curse falls on Thoovathors sea. Kingston, a brave smuggler, and his friends sail into the haunted waters. Their mission: break the curse and save their village.

programme.title: 兄弟帮
programme.desc: 兄弟帮是由一班好兄弟林盛斌梁竞徽王梓轩范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话流行文化潮流玩意等多元化内容

programme.title: 天龙八部 第26集
programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，天龙八部更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 世界观 今日知多D
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地两岸及国际重要新闻

programme.title: 东张西望
programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 第60集
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中

programme.title: 璀璨之城 第16集
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛姜大卫饰在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤张智霖饰官孝君吴卓羲饰，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐

programme.title: 九门 第19集
programme.desc: 九门讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛生死抉择兄弟之情门派担当与家国大义相互交织九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关

programme.title: 美食强人
programme.desc: 由名厨权威品评食家真实试炼，四十间餐厅角逐十强美食代表！视帝陈豪视后龚嘉欣化身美食强人，以焗猪扒饭云吞面西多士乳鸽汉堡包虾饺等十大主题，严选大湾区最强美食指南

programme.title: 娱乐头条
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息

programme.title: 晚间新闻
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 大酱园 第27集
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第8集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变

programme.title: 爱情食物链 第17集
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 第29集
programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量

programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案

programme.title: 大酱园 第29集
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第9集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！

programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第3集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第21集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第36集
programme.desc: 薛家强林峰饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复......

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第1集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 解决师 第19集
programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命

programme.title: 無限大工程 第1季第1集 -休士頓圓頂
programme.desc: 本集討論在休士頓市中心上方興建圓頂建築的可能性在英國康瓦耳郡, 建築師利用創新的概念, 搭建出室內伊甸園, 同樣的做法是否也可應用在休士頓呢?首先, 休士頓並非一片荒蕪的舊礦坑, 市中心裡來往的民眾超過百萬, 因此需要用特別的張力環固定圓頂, 才不至隨風飄走；再則, 休士頓的圓頂需要上萬片板塊, 最佳的材料就是伊甸園也使用過的ETFE, 它具有輕薄堅固的特質, 不僅耐高溫, 也不易髒污；圓頂特殊的三角形樑架, 提供圓頂穩定的力量, 可抵擋五級颶風, 即使有部分脫落, 仍會自動重新分配負重, 保持大結構的完整性；另外圓頂特殊的結構, 加上開口的設計, 可引進冷空氣, 使圓頂內保持涼爽, 減低空調等使用需求如果這項嶄新的工程實驗真的成功了, 它將大大改變建築的面貌, 也將改變人類的生活經驗

programme.title: 父子改車雙動力 第1季第4集 -前進賽道
programme.desc: 道格和布萊德父子檔都熱愛車子父親道格修車起家, 開設車坊, 而兒子從小看到大, 家學淵源使然, 也愛上了賽車, 但一次賽車意外嚴重受傷, 此後挑戰全美房車賽的賽車夢想暫時終止如今布萊德準備再次出發, 一步步往最終的夢想邁進 這對父子繼續改造未上市的2018年野馬, 用上超寬鍛造框和碳纖維輕量化引擎蓋等講究細節, 務期在SEMA車展, 奪得最佳改裝車獎項另一方面, 這對父子巧遇全美房車賽的英雄喬伊羅加諾, 而雙方一見如故, 喬伊提出的方案, 可能讓布萊德距離終極夢想更進一步
